{{Quote|We have reports that Layek Davos--an Imperial admiral who fought in the Battle of Hoth--is assembling an expedition to the starship graveyard. He's after a long list of salvage, the Starbreeze included. Join Admiral Davos and get that shuttle to us instead.|SIS official Ardun Kothe briefs Cipher Nine on a mission on Hoth|<ref name="FE" />}}
'''Imperial Search and Recovery''' was a division of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Leo Furth]] was part of Search and Recovery, and the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]]'s [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ath'en'terro]] was permanently attached to Search and Recovery on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
